name: Run an agent on my machine (Claude Code / Codex)
what: Start, steer and stop agents by driving the user's own CLIs; many in parallel in git worktrees.

name: The terminal UI
what: Prompt, transcript, diff view, status line, command palette, spinner, keybindings, settings, onboarding.

name: Approvals and permissions
what: One policy engine and one prompt for both CLIs; remote approvals for teammates.

name: Mascot and theme
what: Cento in the terminal and on the web, the Abyss/Shallows theme, mascot state rules.

name: Skills, MCP, hooks, memory
what: Configure and display the CLIs' own skills, MCP servers, hooks and CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

name: Provider sign-in and who-pays
what: Detect the user's CLIs, hand off to their own login, show whose account runs what, block shared subscription use by default.

name: LAN multiplayer
what: Discover, pair with a code, host and join a session on the same network with no backend.

name: End-to-end encryption
what: Per-session keys, key grants, rotation; the relay only sees ciphertext and a small metadata set.

name: The command-post queue
what: Guests queue prompts, the host approves, reorders and runs them.

name: Host controls
what: Kick, mute, change roles, transfer host, end session, session policy.

name: Presence, typing and cursors
what: Who is here, what they are doing, shared cursors.

name: Reliable realtime connection
what: Handshake, heartbeat, sequencing, acks, resume, snapshots, backpressure, reconnect.

name: Sign in to Centcom
what: Device flow in the terminal, PKCE in the browser, tokens, refresh, revoke.

name: Devices and API keys
what: Register devices with their public keys, revoke them, manage API keys.

name: Hosted sessions
what: Create, join, pause, end and claim host on the relay; share links for viewers.

name: Workspaces, members and roles
what: Teams, roles, permissions, projects, policies.

name: Invites and join links
what: Email or link invites, deep links, key bundles for offline joins.

name: Plans, seats and checkout
what: Free/Pro/Team, Stripe checkout and portal, seat changes, invoices, trials, dunning.

name: Usage and quotas
what: Server-side relay metering, warnings at 80% and 100%, informational client usage display.

name: Notifications
what: Inbox, push, preferences, quiet hours, OS notifications.

name: Branch-mode fleet
what: Everyone runs agents on their own branches and sees each other's state.

name: File locks and conflicts
what: Advisory locks, conflict signals, resolution UX.

name: Handoff, pair mode, reactions
what: Pass work between people, pair on one agent, react and comment.

name: Webhooks
what: Outgoing signed webhooks with retries; management commands.

name: Audit log
what: Who did what, export, retention by plan.

name: Feature flags and kill switches
what: Remote config, including the provider kill switches.

name: Updates and releases
what: Release channels, signed artifacts, auto-update.

name: Opt-in telemetry and crash help
what: Anonymous, content-free product telemetry; local crash reports.

name: Web app
what: Login, session view, fleet, roster, members, invites, billing, settings, accessibility, e2e tests.

name: Status and health
what: Health endpoints and the public status feed.

name: Operations and security
what: Infrastructure, deploys, observability, alerting, load and chaos tests, hardening, backups, threat model.

name: Contracts, mocks and conformance
what: Codegen, mock backend, client simulator, and the suites that prove both sides agree.
